correctness.rationale: The projective action exhausts the nonzero 15-bit forms. On each affine chart the ideal of the equation and its two derivatives detects geometric singularity exactly. A smooth plane quartic has no line component, and the first nonzero coefficient of the tangent restriction in a local parameter gives the claimed contact order. Independent replay: run python3 /workspace/reproductions/audit_quartics_f2.py with the frozen quartic package directory as its argument. It enumerates all masks directly by binary linear conditions for singularity at points over fields of orders 2, 4, 8 and 16. This cutoff is exact: an absolutely irreducible singular quartic has sum of geometric delta invariants at most three by the genus formula; a reduced reducible quartic of component degrees (3,1) or (2,2) has a Frobenius-stable intersection scheme of length at most four, of degrees (2,1,1) has a rational intersection of its two lines, and of degrees (1,1,1,1) has Frobenius orbits of pair intersections of size at most four. In the nonreduced case a unique repeated component is a rational line or conic with a rational point, or the two repeated lines intersect rationally. A separate elementary-generator orbit traversal and a 21-flag tangent-restriction calculation matched all 34 histogram rows and all 78 representative masks, sizes and contact data in both the TSV and JSON, with 279 orbits in the ambient nonzero space and 10,920 smooth equations. The stated weighted totals, extrema, and the two exceptional single orbits all match.
residual_risks: Classifies only rational contacts over F2, not contact schemes over extensions.

evidence: Nart–Ritzenthaler classify characteristic-two quartics by rational normal models and class counts. Pacini–Testa's reconstruction theorem assumes characteristic coprime to six; their characteristic-two theorem concerns general theta hyperplanes.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The normal models give the input classes, but class counts do not evaluate contact orders or their correlations with point count. The generic theta result does not enumerate arithmetic tangent profiles on all small-field curves.

A complete old list of equations makes this possible; it does not state the refined invariant or make it a projection of its tabulated statistics.
